name: Formatrice des novices
description: Slim adult female, light sand skin with rust mottling, long fine but thick anatomical tendrils swept to one side. Modest moss-green coat with geometric stitched hems, forearm bracers and plain utility pouch. Holds a small lesson tablet in left hand and points to its surface using a wooden stylus, no readable text.

Realistic hand-painted game rendering with natural materials, readable full-body silhouette. Slight elevated orthographic view; body gently screen-right, face close to frontal three-quarter to show four mandibles. Entire head, all tendrils, hands, tools, and both three-clawed feet entirely inside image with8percent clear margin. Figure fills80percent canvas height.
